# M2 Health Information Provider: Create and link records

## In plain words

Milestone 2, sharing records as a [HIP](hip.md): turning your records
into [FHIR](fhir.md) bundles, grouping them into
[care contexts](/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/care-context), linking those to a patient's
[ABHA address](abha-address.md), answering [discovery](discovery.md), and
encrypting and pushing data when consent allows. See
[M2](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2).

## Before you start

Nothing. A glossary entry assumes no prior reading.

## What happens

Nothing happens here. This entry defines a term, it does not describe a call.

## How you know it worked

You have understood this when you can say whether your system holds records that other systems should be able to find.

## When it goes wrong

Assuming M2 alone makes records visible. Nothing you hold is
discoverable until a care context is linked.

reply.Text:
**Milestone 2 (M2)** is the ABDM phase for Health Information Providers (HIPs) covering:

- **Converting records to FHIR bundles** — transforming your records into the standardized health data format
- **Organizing into care contexts** — grouping records by patient encounter or episode
- **Linking to ABHA addresses** — associating care contexts with patient identifiers so records are discoverable
- **Handling discovery requests** — responding when other systems search for a patient's records
- **Sending encrypted data** — pushing records to authorized requesters when consent permits

The key point: M2 is about making your records **discoverable and shareable** through ABDM's HIE-CM gateway. Records you hold won't show up in discovery until you've completed the M2 workflow and linked them to a patient's ABHA address.

See the [M2 API documentation](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2) on the developer portal for implementation details.
